name: agentic/image-with-text
title: Image With Text
description: Split section: image on one side, heading/text/CTA on the other. Set backgroundColor + imageStyle:"inset" for a colored promo panel with a contained (not edge-bleed) image. `imageUrlMobile` is optional — a smaller derivative of `imageUrl` served via `srcset` below the block's 780px stack breakpoint, since this is a static theme asset (not a media-library attachment) with no automatic WordPress srcset of its own; omit it and the block renders exactly as before, one file at every width.
